text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm going to land a small Terraform change in the infra repo that adds a `scalingWindow` on the Karpenter provisioner and renames the secret used by the node-annotator from `annotator-creds` to `node-annotator-cred`. Want a quick safety check on HPA/VPA interactions and secret propagation to nodes in staging. :eyes:
ajay: ping — what's the expected impact on scale-up latency if scalingWindow is set to 3m vs 30s? We had some previous flapping with short windows.
maria: Good q. Plan is `scalingWindow: 3m` for now to avoid rapid churn during deployments. We already have kube HPA configured with stabilizationWindowSeconds=60 in most services, so 3m should be mellow.
devon: Quick check: are we also touching consolidation/ttlSeconds? Last time consolidation + small ttl caused quicker drains during canaries.
maria: Not changing consolidation here. ttlSecondsAfterEmpty stays 300. Only `scalingWindow` + secret rename.
sam: About the secret rename — will the new name be applied to the DaemonSet that mounts creds for the annotator? I remember the node-annotator reads from `/etc/annotator/creds` using a projected secret.
maria: Yes. Terraform will update the kubernetes_secret resource and the daemonset manifests in the repo (staging overlay). Plan: rollout in staging, validate, then prod.
ajay: Can you paste the TF snippet? quick scan would help.
maria: Sure — snippet from the change:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "node_annotator" {
  metadata {
    name = "node-annotator-cred"
    namespace = "kube-system"
  }
  data = {
    key = filebase64("../secrets/annotator.key")
  }
}

module "karpenter_provisioner" {
  source = "./modules/karpenter_provisioner"
  scaling_window = 180  # seconds
  secret_name = kubernetes_secret.node_annotator.metadata[0].name
}
```
ndevon: Looks fine. Two quick suggestions: 1) add a `depends_on` between the provisioning module and the secret resource so TF doesn't race. 2) update RBAC ClusterRoleBinding name check — if the annotator service account is referenced by old secret name anywhere in overlays.
maria: good call. I'll add `depends_on = [kubernetes_secret.node_annotator]` and do a repo grep for `annotator-creds`.
sam: For testing, I'll deploy to staging using the test manifest. Steps I'll run: 
```
kubectl apply -f overlays/staging/daemonsets/node-annotator.yaml -n kube-system
kubectl rollout status ds/node-annotator -n kube-system
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l app=node-annotator -o wide
```
Also will manually `kubectl describe hpa` on a couple services to confirm no immediate scaling surges.
ajay: One more: VPA — we run VPA in recommendation mode for most services, right? If it switches to auto later it can change pod resources and trigger scale events. Make sure the TF changes don't nudge pod templates unexpectedly.
maria: VPA is recommender only in staging and prod for now. We're not altering deployments or resource requests in this PR.
autoscale-bot: [notice] consolidation: provisioner/karpenter-provisioner observed consolidation event; scaled down 1 node in staging at 2024-05-02T17:43:12Z.
devon: Thanks @autoscale-bot — good to have that context.
sam: After the secret rename, ensure the secret is present on existing nodes' projected mounts — sometimes kubelet caches cause an old pod to keep missing secret until restart. I'll watch daemonset rollout carefully.
maria: Plan: apply TF, wait for secret resource, then update daemonset, then watch rollout. If anything looks off I will rollback TF and re-create old secret name as a duplicate (short lived).
ajay: If you need a quick canary, I can pin a lightweight service behind HPA to spot-check scale-up latency before wider rollout.
maria: That'd be great, thanks. I'll tag you when ready.
devon: One extra test command I run for HPA/VPA interplay: 
```
kubectl apply -f test-load.yaml -n staging 
sleep 30
kubectl top pods -n staging | sort -r -k2 | head
kubectl describe hpa test-service -n staging
```
sam: Sounds good. Anything else before you land it?
maria: I'll add the depends_on, run `make infra-plan` in CI, and post the plan output here. If no objections in 2 hours I'll merge and trigger apply in staging. :shipit:
ajay: :+1:
devon: :thumbsup:
autoscale-bot: [info] terraform plan completed for workspace=staging at 2024-05-02T18:05:00Z.
